title: Location filter defaults to the user's active location on first load
permissions_required: Sales By Customer report View permission; user with access to at least two locations.
preconditions: 1. Your browser has no saved view for this report.
2. You are working in a known active location (check the application's location switcher).
steps: 1. Open the Sales By Customer report.
2. Read the location filter's current selection.
expected: 1. The filter defaults to the single location you are currently working in (your active location) — not all locations.
